text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer-san from that day! Guess what, 
I got another delightful message from her!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ever since the incident with the transfer 
student, we had become close enough to 
chat whenever we crossed paths. ...Then, 
one day.

text_block_list.name: Tachyon & Pokke
text_block_list.text: Daaaaaaaaahhhhhhh!! Haha, ahahahaha——!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A fierce duel between Agnes Tachyon and 
Jungle Pocket was taking place on the 
turf.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The spectator stands were in an uproar 
over the high-level clash! Among them was 
Dantsu Flame. However—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...They really are incredible.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her muttered words were unexpectedly 
quiet— Unable to get that sight out of my 
head, later that night...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: *pant, huff, pant, huff*!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
*huff, pant, haah*... Nnngh, my 
acceleration is still too weak... 
...Alright, one more lap...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In stark contrast to her usual self, I saw 
a dead-serious Dantsu Flame.
choice_data_list:
(She can make an expression like that, 
too...?)

(She can make an expression like that, 
too...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Forgetting to even call out, I stared in 
fascination. And just then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*sparkle...!*)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Eh...?! A shooting star?! Ah, I gotta make 
a wish!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ummm...! I want to win...! I want to win, 
I really want to win...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Someday, I want to stand right in the 
middle of that stage, shining brighter 
than anyone else—yes.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...I, I want to be the protagonist. Me 
too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her whispered prayer carried such 
undeniable heat that it took my breath 
away—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ......... Huh? Oh? Trainer-san?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, good work today! Are you working 
this late?
choice_data_list:
Y-Yeah, pretty much. ...Training this late 
yourself?

Y-Yeah, pretty much. ...Training this late 
yourself?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. I just felt like running for some 
reason! So I went for a run~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before I realized it, that burning passion 
she carried had vanished without a trace, 
as if it were an illusion.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...? What's the matter?
choice_data_list:
...I was just thinking you can make that 
kind of expression too.

...I was just thinking you can make that 
kind of expression too.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Eh. Y-You heard that?!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, how embarrassing~. Well, um... I'm 
an umamusume too, after all.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
It's like, I can't stay a background 
character forever~. Something like that. 
Ahaha.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though our conversation returned to 
normal, the mood remained. She wouldn't 
let me see "that" side of her again.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dantsu Flame is approachable, cheerful, 
and gentle.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yet unexpectedly, she might be the type 
with a remarkably thick final wall around 
her heart.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Umm~? What's wrong?
choice_data_list: Nothing. ...I hope your dream comes true.
Nothing. ...I hope your dream comes true.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Yes! I'll do my best in my own way!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Alright, maybe I'll go for one more lap!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dantsu Flame dashes off. Heading toward 
the light hidden deep within her heart.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
W-Waaah~. So that's how it was. That's so 
embarrassing~.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! I have some pudding today. 
Would you like some if you want?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I ended up receiving some of 
Dantsu Flame's homemade pudding—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I made it with extra caramel this time~. I 
hope it suits your taste.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The atmosphere had shifted, making it 
impossible to press into deeper topics 
like the dreams she holds.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Was it simply a subject Dantsu Flame felt 
uncomfortable discussing?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Or perhaps— she's the type whose final 
wall is deceptively thick.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. I wonder if it turned out well this 
time. ...How is it? How's the flavor?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The homemade pudding was sweet, tender, 
and bittersweet.
